hypothesis_text: The critic agent successfully identifies flawed hypotheses because hypotheses it flags as flawed are, on inspection, flawed. This validates the critic-in-loop design for Phase 2.
flaw_description: The validation criterion ('on inspection, flawed') is the same judgment the critic is being evaluated against. If the inspector and the critic agree, that is consistency, not validity. A proper evaluation needs an independent ground-truth label (e.g., this fixture set) and inter-rater agreement against an outside reviewer.
expected_critique_targets: validation set has no independent ground truth
critic and inspector are the same judgment
context: The Day-39 critic eval was reported without using the fixture set's ground_truth_label.
